Proposed positions currently agree among `app_program/common/robot_data.h`, `docs/architecture.md`, the project-spec fault table, and `scripts/mqtt_client.py`:
- Motion S2: bit 0 motor stall; bit 1 encoder
- Line S3: bit 0 IR invalid; bit 1 capture overflow; bit 2 event overflow
- Terrain S4: bit 0 IMU; bit 1 calibration failure; bit 2 impact
- Obstacle S5: bit 0 no echo
- Mission: bit 0 line lost
- Network S1/kernel: bit 0 Wi-Fi lost; bit 1 broker lost

**Please have each owner explicitly confirm or propose corrections for their own byte in this issue/PR review.** Nicholas can then remove PROVISIONAL markers only after approvals and reconcile any changed positions across firmware, docs and the laptop decoder.
